svg.title: SIB1-NB ASN.1 UPER bit walk
svg.text: Reading SIB1-NB bit by bit: 26 bytes from the air → the JSON-like text in my console
payload (hex, exactly as printed): 40 c5 10 a8 80 42 ad 72 43 04 fb d0 cb 07 0d 08 92 c2 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
bits 143–207: zero padding (the transport block is fixed at 208 bits)
